title: TREASURY TO ISSUE NEW 20-YEAR BOND IN FIRST HALF OF 2020 | U.S. Department of the Treasury
主要内容: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced plans to issue a 20-year nominal coupon bond in the first half of 2020. This follows previous exploration of long-term debt products, including 50-year and 100-year bonds, and floating-rate notes linked to the Secured Overnight Financing Rate. Treasury Secretary Steven T. Mnuchin acknowledged the input from market participants, including the Treasury Borrowing Advisory Committee and primary dealers, in the decision to launch the 20-year bond. The move aims to finance the government at the least possible cost to taxpayers. Treasury expects strong demand from investors for the bond, which will enhance its long-term financing capacity. The bond will be issued in a regular and predictable manner in benchmark size. Additional details will be provided in the quarterly refunding statement on February 5, 2020.
